description: Have you heard of this New Ai Tool? Imaginetive 🤔
transcript: This new AI tool creates unlimited ads for you in one prompt. And the scary part? They actually convert. It's called imaginative. You literally just paste your product URL. And in seconds you get 50 to 100 fully branded ad creatives ready to launch. No designers, no Canva, no Photoshop, no expensive shoots. And the craziest part, these ads do not look like AI generated content anymore. Some of these brands are getting 3 x, 5 x, even 10 x ROAS using these and are scaling like crazy. This is why the fastest growing brands are producing hundreds of creatives every single month now. AI just changed advertising forever. Comment AI and I'll send the tool.
